jobs.title: Salesforce Administrator
jobs.location: New York, NY (hybrid; job page heading says Atlanta, but application explicitly accepts New York; office-first guidance generally three days weekly)
jobs.salary: $104,325–$139,100 base for listed eligible states including New York; potential discretionary bonus/equity; fully above $100K
jobs.why: Strong Salesforce Business Systems fit. OneTrust seeks declarative Salesforce configuration, Flow automation, root-cause investigation, functional QA/UAT, controlled releases, documentation and stakeholder collaboration. Audrey has built Salesforce record-triggered Flow, configured fields/formulas/validation rules, coordinated UAT and defects, cleaned legacy CRM data, mapped processes, and trained stakeholders at Orion Worldwide. The role explicitly allows growth toward broader solution ownership.
jobs.gap: No verified independent production Salesforce administrator ownership, Gearset release management, Apex test execution, Lead-to-Cash/CPQ, or advanced Flow pattern mastery. Salesforce certification is preferred rather than required.
